people.name: Adam
people.notes: Made from the dust and given the breath of God. Sinned, was clothed by God with skins, and heard the first promise: the woman’s Seed would bruise the serpent’s head.

people.name: Eve
people.notes: Deceived by the serpent; the promise of the Seed was given through her.

people.name: Cain
people.notes: Brought the fruit of the ground; his offering was not accepted; killed his brother and went out from the presence of the LORD. The first city was his.

people.name: Abel
people.notes: Brought of the firstlings of his flock and the fat; God had respect to his offering. The first name on the faith line.

people.name: Seth
people.notes: “God hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel.” In his days men began to call upon the name of the LORD.

people.name: Enoch
people.notes: Cain’s son; the first city was named after him.

people.name: Lamech
people.notes: Took two wives, boasted of killing a man, and sang the first song of vengeance.

people.name: Tubal-cain
people.notes: “An instructer of every artificer in brass and iron.” Cain’s line was gifted, and it was godless.

people.name: Enoch
people.notes: “Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.” The seventh from Adam, the first man caught away without dying.

people.name: Methuselah
people.meaning: when he dies, it is sent
people.notes: The longest life in the Bible; he died in the year of the Flood — the judgment waited as long as he lived.

people.name: Lamech
people.notes: Named his son Noah: “this same shall comfort us concerning our work.”

people.name: Noah
people.notes: “Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.” A preacher of righteousness who built an ark by faith and carried the whole human family through the Flood.

people.name: Japheth
people.notes: “God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem.”

people.name: Elishah
people.notes: “By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands.”

people.name: Tarshish
people.notes: “By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands.”

people.name: Kittim
people.notes: “By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands.”

people.name: Dodanim
people.notes: “By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands.”

people.name: Ham
people.role: father of Cush, Mizraim, Phut and Canaan
people.notes: Uncovered his father’s nakedness; his son Canaan carried the curse.

people.name: Canaan
people.role: the land was named for him
people.notes: The peoples Israel would drive out came from him.

people.name: Nimrod
people.notes: “A mighty hunter before the LORD”; the beginning of his kingdom was Babel. Babylon starts here.

people.name: Casluhim
people.notes: “Out of whom came Philistim” — the Philistines.

people.name: Shem
people.notes: “Blessed be the LORD God of Shem.” The line of the promise runs through him to Abraham.

people.name: Asshur
people.notes: Assyria.

people.name: Aram
people.notes: Syria.

people.name: Peleg
people.notes: “In his days was the earth divided” — the scattering from Babel.

people.name: Ophir
people.notes: The gold of Ophir came to Solomon from here.

people.name: Terah
people.notes: Served other gods beyond the river; set out from Ur for Canaan and stopped at Haran, and died there.

people.name: Haran
people.notes: Died before his father in Ur; father of Lot, Milcah and Iscah.

people.name: Lot
people.notes: Chose the well-watered plain; lost everything at Sodom but his life. Father of Moab and Ammon.

people.name: Moab
people.notes: Ruth came from his people.

people.name: Nahor
people.notes: Stayed in Haran; grandfather of Rebekah, great-grandfather of Leah and Rachel.

people.name: Laban
people.notes: Jacob’s uncle and father-in-law; changed his wages ten times.

people.name: Abraham
people.notes: Called out of Ur; believed God in the dark, and it was counted to him for righteousness. The father of the faithful — the blue line’s covenant man.

people.name: Sarah
people.notes: “Through faith also Sara herself received strength.” Mother of Isaac at ninety; the free woman of Galatians 4.

people.name: Hagar
people.notes: The LORD found her by a well and named her son.

people.name: Ishmael
people.notes: A wild man; blessed, but not the son of the promise.

people.name: Nebajoth
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Kedar
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Adbeel
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Mibsam
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Mishma
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Dumah
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Massa
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Hadar
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Tema
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Jetur
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Naphish
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Kedemah
people.notes: One of the twelve princes of Ishmael.

people.name: Midian
people.notes: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, was a priest of Midian.

people.name: Isaac
people.notes: Bound on Moriah and given back; “in Isaac shall thy seed be called.”

people.name: Rebekah
people.role: the bride fetched by the servant
people.notes: Said “I will go” before she had seen Isaac.

people.name: Esau
people.notes: Sold his birthright for one meal; “found no place of repentance.”

people.name: Amalek
people.notes: Born of Timna, Eliphaz’s concubine. Israel’s enemy from the wilderness to Saul’s day.

people.name: Jacob · Israel
people.notes: Wrestled at Peniel and was renamed Israel; blessed Judah with the sceptre.

people.name: Leah
people.role: mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Rachel
people.notes: Buried by the road to Bethlehem.

people.name: Reuben
people.notes: Unstable as water; lost the birthright.

people.name: Simeon
people.notes: Instruments of cruelty; scattered in Israel.

people.name: Levi
people.notes: Scattered — into the priesthood. Moses, Aaron and the priests come from him.

people.name: Judah
people.notes: “The sceptre shall not depart from Judah… until Shiloh come.” The royal tribe: the gold line starts here.

people.name: Dan
people.notes: A serpent by the way.

people.name: Naphtali
people.notes: A hind let loose.

people.name: Gad
people.notes: A troop shall overcome him, but he shall overcome at the last.

people.name: Asher
people.notes: His bread shall be fat.

people.name: Beriah
people.notes: Father of Heber and Malchiel.

people.name: Serah
people.notes: Asher’s daughter — the one granddaughter named among the seventy.

people.name: Issachar
people.notes: A strong ass couching down between two burdens.

people.name: Zebulun
people.notes: By the haven of the sea.

people.name: Joseph
people.notes: A fruitful bough; sold by his brothers, saved them from the famine. Ephraim and Manasseh received his double portion.

people.name: Benjamin
people.notes: A ravening wolf. Saul, Israel’s first king, and Paul the apostle were Benjamites.

people.name: Asenath
people.role: daughter of Potipherah, priest of On

people.name: Tamar
people.role: the first woman in Matthew’s genealogy
people.notes: Wronged, then vindicated: “She hath been more righteous than I.”

people.name: Er
people.notes: Wicked in the sight of the LORD.

people.name: Pharez
people.notes: Broke out first, ahead of his twin Zerah — the royal line runs through the breach.

people.name: Zerah
people.notes: The scarlet thread was on his hand first.

people.name: Jochebed
people.notes: Hid her son three months, then trusted him to the river and to God.

people.name: Korah
people.notes: Led the rebellion in the wilderness; the earth opened. His sons did not die — the sons of Korah wrote psalms.

people.name: Miriam
people.notes: Watched the ark of bulrushes; led the women in song at the sea.

people.name: Aaron
people.notes: Moses’ mouth before Pharaoh; the golden calf; the priesthood.

people.name: Elisheba
people.role: daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon
people.notes: Judah and Levi joined in one marriage.

people.name: Moses
people.notes: “There arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face.”

people.name: Zipporah
people.role: daughter of Jethro, priest of Midian

people.name: Nadab
people.notes: Offered strange fire and died before the LORD.

people.name: Abihu
people.notes: Offered strange fire and died before the LORD.

people.name: Eleazar
people.notes: High priest after Aaron; father of Phinehas.

people.name: Phinehas
people.notes: His zeal at Baal-peor won an everlasting priesthood.

people.name: Caleb (Chelubai)
people.notes: Not the spy — an older Caleb of Judah.

people.name: Amminadab
people.notes: His daughter Elisheba married Aaron; his son Nahshon led Judah in the wilderness.

people.name: Nahshon
people.notes: Prince of Judah in the wilderness; first to bring his offering at the tabernacle.

people.name: Salmon
people.notes: Married Rahab of Jericho — the harlot who hid the spies and believed.

people.name: Boaz
people.notes: The kinsman-redeemer of Bethlehem, who bought the field and took the Gentile widow as his bride.

people.name: Obed
people.notes: “There is a son born to Naomi.”

people.name: Jesse
people.notes: The Bethlehemite with eight sons; “there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse.”

people.name: David
people.notes: The shepherd-king, a man after God’s own heart, who received the oath of an everlasting throne. Both Lines run through him.

people.name: Rahab
people.role: the woman of Jericho saved by a scarlet cord

people.name: Ruth
people.role: the Moabite bride — where the two Lines touch
people.notes: “Thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God.”

people.name: Eliab
people.notes: Jesse’s firstborn — “Look not on his countenance.”

people.name: Michal
people.notes: Let David down through a window; later despised him for dancing before the ark.

people.name: Abigail
people.notes: Her wisdom turned David from bloodshed.

people.name: Bathsheba
people.role: mother of Solomon and of Nathan
people.notes: Wife of Uriah, then of David.

people.name: Amnon
people.notes: David’s firstborn; violated Tamar; killed by Absalom.

people.name: Absalom
people.notes: Stole the hearts of Israel; hung by his hair in an oak.

people.name: Adonijah
people.notes: “I will be king” — and was not.

people.name: Saul
people.role: Israel’s first king — the people’s choice
people.notes: Tall, from Benjamin, hiding among the baggage; lost the throne by partial obedience.

people.name: Jonathan
people.notes: “Thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.”

people.name: Ish-bosheth
people.notes: Reigned over Israel from Mahanaim while David reigned in Hebron.

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.notes: Lame in both feet; ate at the king’s table for Jonathan’s sake.

people.name: Nathan
people.notes: David’s son born in Jerusalem. Luke’s line to Mary runs through him — the blood, not the throne.

people.name: Solomon
people.notes: Built the temple; wisest of men; his heart was turned by strange wives. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: good, then a divided heart.

people.name: Rehoboam
people.notes: Whips and scorpions at Shechem; the kingdom split in his hand. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: evil.

people.name: Abijah
people.notes: Walked in his father’s sins, yet trusted God once in battle. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: evil.

people.name: Asa
people.notes: Removed the idols, deposed his own grandmother; relied on Syria late in life. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: good.

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.notes: Sent teachers through Judah; allied with Ahab, and was rebuked for it. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: good.

people.name: Jehoram
people.notes: Married Ahab’s daughter; killed his brothers; died of a disease, unlamented. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: evil.

people.name: Ahaziah
people.notes: Reigned one year; killed by Jehu. (Not listed in Matthew.) Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: evil.

people.name: Joash
people.notes: Hidden in the house of God six years from Athaliah; crowned at seven; repaired the temple; had the priest’s son stoned. (Not in Matthew.) Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: good, then fell.

people.name: Amaziah
people.notes: Defeated Edom, then worshipped Edom’s gods. (Not in Matthew.) Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: good, then fell.

people.name: Uzziah · Azariah
people.notes: Strong while he sought the LORD; struck with leprosy for entering the temple. Isaiah’s call came the year he died. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: good, then proud.

people.name: Jotham
people.notes: “Became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD.” Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: good.

people.name: Ahaz
people.notes: Burned his children in the fire; refused the sign, and got one anyway — “a virgin shall conceive.” Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: evil.

people.name: Hezekiah
people.notes: Spread Sennacherib’s letter before the LORD; the angel struck the Assyrian camp; fifteen years added to his life. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: good.

people.name: Manasseh
people.notes: The worst king Judah had — and, in a Babylonian prison, he humbled himself greatly, and God heard him. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: evil, then repented.

people.name: Amon
people.notes: Two years; killed by his own servants. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: evil.

people.name: Josiah
people.notes: The boy-king who found the Book in the house and rent his clothes; the last great reform. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: good.

people.name: Jehoiakim
people.notes: Cut Jeremiah’s scroll with a penknife and burned it. (Not in Matthew.) Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: evil.

people.name: Jeconiah · Jehoiachin
people.notes: Carried to Babylon; “write ye this man childless.” Matthew’s line passes through him by law; Luke’s bloodline goes round him. Verdict of Kings and Chronicles: evil.

people.name: Athaliah
people.notes: Killed the royal seed — all but one baby, hidden in the house of God for six years.

people.name: Zedekiah
people.notes: Saw his sons killed, then his eyes put out; Jerusalem burned.

people.name: Jehoahaz
people.notes: Three months; carried to Egypt.

people.name: Jeroboam
people.notes: Ten tribes went with him; two golden calves at Bethel and Dan — the religion of convenience.

people.name: Nadab
people.notes: Killed by Baasha; Jeroboam’s house ended.

people.name: Elah
people.notes: Killed drunk by Zimri.

people.name: Zimri
people.notes: Seven days; burned the palace over himself.

people.name: Omri
people.notes: Built Samaria; “did worse than all that were before him.”

people.name: Ahab
people.notes: Married Jezebel; Baal in Israel; Elijah on Carmel; Naboth’s vineyard.

people.name: Ahaziah
people.notes: Fell through a lattice; sent to Baal-zebub; died as Elijah said.

people.name: Jehoram · Joram
people.notes: The last of Ahab’s house; shot by Jehu in Naboth’s field.

people.name: Jehu
people.notes: Drove furiously; ended Ahab’s house and Baal’s temple; kept the calves.

people.name: Jehoash · Joash
people.notes: Wept over the dying Elisha; struck the ground three times.

people.name: Jeroboam II
people.notes: Boom-times and rot; Amos and Hosea preached in his days.

people.name: Zachariah
people.notes: Six months; the fourth generation of Jehu, as promised.

people.name: Shallum
people.notes: One month.

people.name: Menahem
people.notes: Paid tribute to Assyria.

people.name: Pekah
people.notes: Lost Galilee to Tiglath-pileser.

people.name: Hoshea
people.notes: The last king of Israel; Samaria fell, and the ten tribes went into Assyria.

people.name: Jezebel
people.role: daughter of Ethbaal, king of the Zidonians
people.notes: Killed the prophets of the LORD; her name became a warning.

people.name: Mattatha
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Menan
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Melea
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Eliakim
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Jonan
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Joseph

people.name: Simeon

people.name: Levi

people.name: Jorim
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Jose

people.name: Elmodam
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Cosam

people.name: Addi
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Melchi
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Neri
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy — the line of Nathan the son of David.

people.name: Shealtiel
people.notes: Son of Jeconiah in Matthew, son of Neri in Luke — where the two lists meet after the exile.

people.name: Zerubbabel
people.notes: Led the first return from Babylon and laid the temple’s foundation; God’s “signet.”

people.name: Abiud
people.notes: A name Matthew records between the return from Babylon and Joseph.

people.name: Eliakim
people.notes: A name Matthew records between the return from Babylon and Joseph.

people.name: Azor
people.notes: A name Matthew records between the return from Babylon and Joseph.

people.name: Sadoc
people.notes: A name Matthew records between the return from Babylon and Joseph.

people.notes: A name Matthew records between the return from Babylon and Joseph.

people.notes: A name Matthew records between the return from Babylon and Joseph.

people.name: Matthan
people.notes: A name Matthew records between the return from Babylon and Joseph.

people.name: Jacob
people.notes: A name Matthew records between the return from Babylon and Joseph.

people.name: Rhesa
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Joanna
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Juda
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Joseph
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Amos
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Mattathias
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Joseph
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Janna
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Melchi
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Levi
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Matthat
people.notes: A name in Luke’s genealogy after Zerubbabel.

people.name: Heli
people.notes: Luke’s last name before Joseph — read by many as Mary’s father, making Luke’s list her bloodline.

people.name: Joseph
people.notes: A just man; the legal father who gave the Son of David His claim to the throne.

people.name: Mary
people.notes: “Blessed art thou among women.” Of the house of David by blood; she said, be it unto me according to thy word.

people.name: JESUS CHRIST
people.role: the Son of David and the Son of God
people.notes: The throne line and the faith line meet in Him: King of the Jews on the Cross, and the Bridegroom of the Bride. “I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.”

people.name: Elisabeth
people.role: of the daughters of Aaron, Mary’s cousin

people.name: Zacharias
people.role: a priest of the course of Abia
people.notes: Struck dumb until the child was named.

people.name: John the Baptist
people.notes: “Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater.”

people.name: Dedan
people.notes: Father of the Asshurim, Letushim and Leummim.

people.name: Teman
people.notes: A duke of Edom, of the sons of Eliphaz.

people.name: Omar
people.notes: A duke of Edom, of the sons of Eliphaz.

people.name: Zepho
people.notes: A duke of Edom, of the sons of Eliphaz.

people.name: Gatam
people.notes: A duke of Edom, of the sons of Eliphaz.

people.name: Kenaz
people.notes: A duke of Edom, of the sons of Eliphaz.

people.name: Nahath
people.notes: A duke of Edom, of the sons of Reuel.

people.name: Zerah
people.notes: A duke of Edom, of the sons of Reuel.

people.name: Shammah
people.notes: A duke of Edom, of the sons of Reuel.

people.name: Mizzah
people.notes: A duke of Edom, of the sons of Reuel.

people.name: Timnah
people.notes: One of the dukes “that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names.”

people.name: Alvah
people.notes: One of the dukes “that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names.”

people.name: Jetheth

people.name: Elah

people.name: Mibzar

people.name: Magdiel
people.notes: One of the dukes “that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names.”

people.name: Iram
people.notes: One of the dukes “that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names.”

people.name: Seir
people.notes: The land — and its first people — that Esau’s sons dispossessed and married into.

people.name: Timna
people.notes: Concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; mother of Amalek.

people.name: Ajah
people.notes: Found the mules (“the mules”, KJV margin “the hot springs”) in the wilderness, as he fed his father’s asses.

people.name: Anah
people.notes: Father, by most readings, of Aholibamah, Esau’s wife.

people.name: Elizur
people.notes: One of the twelve princes who numbered Israel and offered at the tabernacle’s dedication.

people.name: Shelumiel
people.notes: One of the twelve princes who numbered Israel and offered at the tabernacle’s dedication.

people.name: Nethaneel
people.notes: One of the twelve princes who numbered Israel and offered at the tabernacle’s dedication.

people.name: Abidan

people.name: Ahiezer

people.name: Pagiel
people.notes: One of the twelve princes who numbered Israel and offered at the tabernacle’s dedication.

people.name: Deuel
people.notes: Called Reuel in Numbers 2:14.

people.name: Eliasaph
people.notes: One of the twelve princes who numbered Israel and offered at the tabernacle’s dedication.

people.name: Ahira
people.notes: One of the twelve princes who numbered Israel and offered at the tabernacle’s dedication.

people.name: Shammua
people.notes: One of the twelve men Moses sent “to spy out the land of Canaan.”

people.name: Shaphat
people.notes: One of the twelve men Moses sent “to spy out the land of Canaan.”

people.name: Geuel

people.name: Aholiab
people.notes: Worked with Bezaleel in building the tabernacle.

people.name: Ezer
people.notes: Slain by the men of Gath, born in the land, when they came down to take away their cattle.

people.name: Elead
people.notes: Slain with his brother Ezer by the men of Gath.

people.name: Beriah
people.notes: “Ephraim their father mourned many days… and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.”

people.name: Joshua
people.notes: The Greek form of his name, Jehoshua, is rendered “Jesus” in Acts 7:45 and Hebrews 4:8. Led Israel across Jordan and took the land; one of the twelve spies, of Ephraim; “as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”

people.name: Machir
people.notes: A man of war; his descendants took Gilead from the Amorites.

people.name: Zelophehad
people.notes: Had no sons; his daughters’ plea set the law that an inheritance could pass to a daughter.

people.name: Shammah
people.notes: Called Shimma (2 Samuel 21:21) and Shimeah (2 Samuel 13:3).

people.name: Jether the Ishmeelite
people.notes: Called Ithra an Israelite in 2 Samuel 17:25.

people.name: Joab
people.notes: Captain of David’s host; killed Abner and Amasa; put to death by Solomon.

people.name: Abishai
people.notes: David’s mighty man; slew three hundred with his spear.

people.name: Asahel
people.notes: Swift of foot; killed by Abner, pursuing him.

people.name: Amasa
people.notes: Made captain of the host by Absalom, then by David; killed by Joab.

people.name: Jonadab
people.notes: “A very subtil man”; counselled Amnon toward Tamar.

people.name: Shammua
people.notes: Called Shimea in 1 Chronicles 14:4.

people.name: Elishama
people.notes: Called Elishua in 2 Samuel 5:15.

people.name: Tamar
people.role: Absalom’s daughter — “a woman of a fair countenance”

people.name: Jarha
people.notes: Sheshan, having no sons, gave his daughter to his servant Jarha to wife.

people.name: Zadok
people.role: high priest under David and Solomon
people.notes: Stayed loyal to David against Absalom and Adonijah; anointed Solomon king at Gihon.

people.name: Ahimaaz
people.notes: Outran the Cushite to bring David news of Absalom’s defeat.

people.name: Azariah
people.notes: Executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built.

people.name: Hilkiah
people.notes: Found the book of the law in the house of the LORD in Josiah’s day.

people.name: Seraiah
people.notes: The chief priest, put to death by the king of Babylon at Riblah.

people.name: Jehozadak
people.notes: Went into captivity when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar.

people.name: Joshua
people.notes: Stood with Zerubbabel to rebuild the altar and the temple; Zechariah saw him in filthy garments, clothed instead with a change of raiment.

people.name: Ezra
people.notes: “A ready scribe in the law of Moses”; led a second return and taught Israel the statutes of the LORD.

people.name: Eli
people.role: priest and judge at Shiloh, 40 years
people.notes: Reared Samuel; fell backward and died at word of the ark’s capture.

people.name: Hophni
people.notes: “Sons of Belial”; slain the same day, and the ark taken.

people.name: Phinehas
people.notes: Slain with his brother Hophni; his wife died bearing Ichabod.

people.name: Ichabod
people.notes: “The glory is departed from Israel: for the ark of God is taken.”

people.name: Ahimelech
people.notes: Gave David the shewbread and Goliath’s sword; slain with the priests of Nob by Doeg at Saul’s word.

people.name: Abiathar
people.role: 4th high priest from Eli, 11th from Aaron
people.notes: Escaped Nob and joined David; thrust out from the priesthood by Solomon for backing Adonijah.

people.name: Jonathan
people.notes: Brought David word from the city in Absalom’s rebellion.

people.name: Jethro
people.notes: Called Reuel (Raguel) and Hobab’s father; counselled Moses to appoint rulers over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.

people.name: Hobab
people.notes: Guided Israel through the wilderness, “instead of eyes.”

people.name: Heber the Kenite
people.notes: Severed from the Kenites; his tent stood by Kedesh.

people.name: Jael
people.notes: “Blessed above women shall Jael…be”; drove a tent nail through Sisera’s temples.

people.name: Hemath
people.role: father of the house of Rechab

people.name: Jehonadab · Jonadab
people.notes: Rode with Jehu against Baal; commanded his sons to drink no wine and dwell in tents — a vow their sons kept two hundred years later, to their honour, before Jeremiah.

people.name: Seled
people.notes: Died without children.

people.name: Sheshan
people.notes: Had no sons, only daughters.

people.name: Jether
people.notes: Died without children.

people.name: Hur
people.notes: Held up Moses’ hands with Aaron at Rephidim.

people.name: Bezaleel
people.notes: Filled with the Spirit of God, in wisdom and in understanding, to work in gold, silver, brass and stone.

people.name: Salma
people.notes: Often identified with Salmon, Boaz’s father.

people.name: Caleb
people.notes: Alone with Joshua brought back a good report of the land; at eighty-five still asked for his mountain.

people.name: Othniel
people.notes: Took Kirjath-sepher (Debir) and won Achsah, Caleb’s daughter, to wife; the Spirit of the LORD came upon him against Chushan-rishathaim.

people.name: Achsah
people.notes: Asked her father for springs of water with the south land he gave her.

people.name: Joab
people.role: father of the valley of Charashim (craftsmen)

people.name: Abner
people.notes: Made Ish-bosheth king over Israel; slain by Joab at Hebron in revenge for Asahel.

people.name: Doeg the Edomite
people.notes: Told Saul of Ahimelech, then slew the priests of Nob at Saul’s word.

people.name: Rizpah
people.notes: Spread sackcloth on the rock and kept the birds from her sons’ bodies till the rain fell.

people.name: Armoni
people.notes: Hanged by the Gibeonites to end the famine of Saul’s bloodguilt.

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.notes: Hanged by the Gibeonites to end the famine of Saul’s bloodguilt.

people.name: Malchi-shua
people.notes: Slain with Saul and Jonathan on Gilboa.

people.name: Abinadab
people.notes: Slain with Saul and Jonathan on Gilboa.

people.name: Ziba
people.notes: Given charge of Mephibosheth’s land; met David fleeing Absalom.

people.name: Jehoadah
people.notes: Called Jarah in 1 Chronicles 9:42.

people.name: Rephaiah
people.notes: Called Raphah in 1 Chronicles 8:37.

people.name: Ehud
people.notes: Left-handed; made a two-edged dagger and slew Eglon, king of Moab, in his summer parlour.

people.name: Baanah
people.notes: Murdered Ish-bosheth in his bed and brought David his head; David had them slain for it.

people.name: Rechab
people.notes: Murdered Ish-bosheth in his bed and brought David his head; David had them slain for it.

people.name: Mordecai
people.role: raised Esther as his own daughter
people.notes: Refused to bow to Haman; uncovered a plot on the king’s life; exalted next to Ahasuerus.

people.name: Esther · Hadassah
people.notes: “Who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?” Risked her life to save her people from Haman’s decree.

people.name: Paul
people.role: of the tribe of Benjamin, an apostle
people.notes: “An Hebrew of the Hebrews… of the tribe of Benjamin”; once Saul the persecutor, sent to the Gentiles.

people.name: Shamgar
people.notes: Slew six hundred Philistines with an ox goad.

people.name: Deborah
people.notes: Sat under the palm tree of Deborah and judged Israel; sang the victory song with Barak.

people.name: Gideon
people.notes: Threshed wheat by the winepress, hiding from Midian; tested the fleece; routed Midian with three hundred men and a trumpet, a pitcher and a lamp.

people.name: Jotham
people.notes: Escaped Abimelech’s slaughter of his seventy brothers; told the parable of the trees.

people.name: Abimelech
people.role: made himself king at Shechem, 3 years
people.notes: Killed his seventy brothers on one stone; a woman broke his skull with a millstone at Thebez.

people.name: Jair
people.notes: Had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and had thirty cities.

people.name: Jephthah
people.notes: Cast out by his brothers; delivered Israel from Ammon; made a rash vow met by his daughter, who came out to meet him.

people.name: Ibzan
people.notes: Thirty sons and thirty daughters.

people.name: Abdon
people.notes: Forty sons and thirty nephews that rode on seventy ass colts.

people.name: Samson
people.role: Nazarite from the womb · thirteenth judge, 20 years
people.notes: Slew a lion with his hands, a thousand Philistines with a jawbone, and pulled down the house of Dagon at his death, “so the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.”

people.name: Delilah
people.notes: Sold Samson to the lords of the Philistines for eleven hundred pieces of silver each.

people.name: Peninnah
people.notes: Provoked Hannah, to make her fret.

people.name: Hannah
people.notes: Prayed in bitterness of soul; lent her son to the LORD “as long as he liveth.”

people.name: Samuel
people.notes: Ministered before the LORD as a child in a linen ephod; anointed Saul, then David.

people.name: Abiah
people.notes: Samuel’s sons “turned aside after lucre” as judges; Israel asked for a king instead.
